coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: One of five ground-truth variable items is substantially matched (20%): torsion-angle autocorrelation, whose cosine form is correctly recovered as the real part of the complex correlation. The remaining specified variables and settings are missing or materially altered.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output omits pooling 30k test-peptide frames and fixed training settings (256-residue crops, every-40-frame subsampling, full-protein inference). It replaces the required 100 fs reference, 10 ps subsampled, and 10 ps-to-100 fs generated comparison with primarily 1 fs reconstruction and multiple strides/baselines. Its autocorrelation lag range differs from 100 fs–100 ps, and it omits dynamic content defined as the negative derivative of autocorrelation with respect to log-timescale.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion states that MDGEN recovers sub-ps oscillations, closely matches reference autocorrelation curves, and produces non-monotonic dynamic content, while subsampled trajectories lack these features.
